How to Rotate Upside-Down PDF Pages and Delete Extra Pages

Published November 2, 2026 · Ubahin Team

Scanned PDFs often have problems: some pages are upside down, turned 90 degrees, or there is a blank page that got scanned too. The two fixes below solve most of these problems.

Rotating pages

  1. Open Rotate PDF and choose your file.
  2. Pick the rotation: 90° clockwise, 180°, or 90° counterclockwise.
  3. If only some pages are upside down, fill in the pages field, for example 2, 4-6. Leave it empty to rotate all pages.
  4. Download the result.

Deleting pages

  1. Open Delete PDF Pages.
  2. Type the page numbers to remove, for example 3, 7-8.
  3. Download the cleaned-up PDF. Your original file is not changed.

Tips

  • Open the PDF in your default reader first to note the problem page numbers.
  • Page numbers are counted with the first page as 1, not by the number printed on the paper.
  • Once it is tidy, you can make it smaller with Compress PDF if needed.
